title: Name color tokens for light/dark
persona: Tanvi, design systems lead at Razorpay
scenario: Razorpay's design system has 84 color tokens with names like ‘blue-500’, ‘blue-500-dark’, ‘primary-blue’, ‘brand-blue-2’. Half the tokens have aliases that drift on dark mode. You want a naming convention that, semantic intent, palette role, theme variant, that scales to the next 100 tokens without anyone having to think. You have 30 minutes before standup.
badPrompt: give me a naming convention for design system color tokens
badOutput: Use semantic names like primary, secondary, success, warning, error. Avoid raw color names. Use a hierarchy like color-category-variant. Apply consistent naming across light and dark themes.

hints.title: Anchor the failure mode
hints.body: Tell Claude what's broken: ‘blue-500-dark’, ‘primary-blue’, ‘brand-blue-2’ are all the same token with drift. The current chaos is the prompt's job to fix.

hints.title: Force a worked example
hints.body: Demand the same token written under the new convention, in light AND dark. Without a worked example, conventions are theoretical.

checks.tip: Frame the artifact, a naming convention, not vibes.
Anchor the domain, color tokens in a design system.
Reference the dark/light theming, that's where conventions break.
Anchor the current chaos, 84 tokens with drift, so Claude has something to fix.
Constrain for scale, ‘scales to the next 100 tokens without thinking’.
Force semantic-intent naming, not raw color names.
Reference the team, standup in 30 minutes. Conventions need to be explainable fast.
Demand alternatives considered + rejected. Conventions without rejected paths are just opinions.
Demand a worked example, the same token under the new convention, in both themes.
Specify the structure, rules + worked example + rejected alternatives.

tipIfLow: Token naming gets generic from AI because it doesn't know your chaos. The unlock is anchoring the actual broken names AND demanding a worked example in both themes. Conventions without examples are theoretical.
goldPrompt: Act as a design-systems lead reviewer. I'm Tanvi at Razorpay. Our 84 colour tokens have names like 'blue-500', 'blue-500-dark', 'primary-blue', 'brand-blue-2' — half drift on dark mode. I have 30 minutes. Propose ONE naming convention with the schema {semantic-intent}-{role}-{theme} (e.g., bg-surface-default, fg-action-pressed). Apply it to those four broken names as a worked example, in light AND dark. Output: convention rules (5 max), worked migration table, and one edge case (e.g., gradients) with how the convention handles it.
